package.scope: One actually admitted Rust native context; full tuple retained and rederived, never a global package-observation identity

owner.scope: New-M3 Rust build-script/proc-macro prepared owners; no workflow/test-runner owner redefinition

pathSelection: sourceKind path requires exact retained in-snapshot Cargo.toml LogicalPath; snapshot-member requires sourceKind path; nonpath dependency source requires null
normalization: None; no trimming, case folding, Unicode normalization, source display splitting, delimiter concatenation, wrapper, domain H or newline
historical: No historical bytes, codec, accepted owner or recipe selection rewritten
